FROM sales_orders LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = sales_orders.customer_id LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = sales_orders.currency_center_id LEFT JOIN customer_contacts ON customer_contacts.id = sales_orders.customer_contact_id LEFT JOIN price_types ON price_types.id = sales_orders.price_type_id LEFT JOIN vat_settings ON vat_settings.id = sales_orders.vat_setting_id LEFT JOIN vat_setting_rates ON vat_setting_rates.id = sales_orders.vat_setting_rate_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = sales_orders.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = sales_orders.modified_by LEFT JOIN employees AS sales_rep ON sales_rep.id = sales_orders.sales_rep_id LEFT JOIN employees AS deliver ON deliver.id = sales_orders.deliver_id LEFT JOIN employees AS collector ON collector.id = sales_orders.collector_id LEFT JOIN location_groups ON location_groups.id = sales_orders.location_group_id LEFT JOIN chart_accounts ON chart_accounts.id = sales_orders.ar_id LEFT JOIN chart_accounts AS vat_chart_accounts ON vat_chart_accounts.id = sales_orders.vat_chart_account_id LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = sales_orders.company_id LEFT JOIN payment_terms ON payment_terms.id = sales_orders.payment_term_id LEFT JOIN credit_memos ON sales_orders.id = credit_memos.sales_order_id AND credit_memos.status > 0

SELECT customers.customer_name_in AS showName, (SELECT COALESCE(`name_kh`, `name`) FROM employees WHERE user_id = sales_orders.created_by) AS createdBy, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdByUser, (SELECT amount_us FROM sales_order_receipts WHERE sales_order_id = #{id} AND is_void = 0) AS paidAmount, (SELECT `change` FROM sales_order_receipts WHERE sales_order_id = #{id} AND is_void = 0) AS `change`, (SELECT exchange_rates.rate_to_sell FROM exchange_rates WHERE exchange_rates.is_active = 1 AND exchange_rates.currency_center_id = 2 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS rateToSell,
WHERE (sales_orders.status >= 0 OR sales_orders.status = -2) AND sales_orders.id = #{id} AND sales_orders.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{userId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_orders ( type, company_id, location_group_id, customer_id, customer_contact_id, currency_center_id, ar_id, payment_term_id, price_type_id, sales_rep_id, quotation_id, quotation_number, order_id, order_number, transfer_order_id, to_code, ut_system_type_id, bom_id, bom_code, customer_po_number, order_date, memo, total_vat, vat_percent, vat_setting_id, vat_setting_rate_id, vat_chart_account_id, vat_calculate, discount, discount_percent, total_amount, balance, total_deposit, recurrence, is_apply, is_pos, is_none_vat, is_deposit, is_approve, is_deposit_reference, status, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{saleInvoice.type}, #{saleInvoice.companyId}, #{saleInvoice.warehouseId}, #{saleInvoice.organizationId}, #{saleInvoice.organizationContactId}, #{saleInvoice.currencyId}, #{saleInvoice.chartAccountId}, #{saleInvoice.paymentTermId}, #{saleInvoice.priceTypeId}, #{saleInvoice.saleRepId}, #{saleInvoice.quotationId}, #{saleInvoice.quotationNumber}, #{saleInvoice.saleOrderId}, #{saleInvoice.saleOrderNumber}, #{saleInvoice.transferOrderId}, #{saleInvoice.transferOrderNumber}, #{saleInvoice.departmentId}, #{saleInvoice.bomId}, #{saleInvoice.bomCode}, #{saleInvoice.organizationPoNo}, #{saleInvoice.invoiceDate}, #{saleInvoice.note}, #{saleInvoice.totalVat}, #{saleInvoice.vatPercent}, #{saleInvoice.vatSettingId}, #{saleInvoice.vatSettingRateId}, #{saleInvoice.vatChartAccountId}, #{saleInvoice.vatCalculate}, #{saleInvoice.discountAmount}, #{saleInvoice.discountPercent}, #{saleInvoice.totalAmount}, #{saleInvoice.balance}, #{saleInvoice.totalDeposit}, #{saleInvoice.recurrence}, #{saleInvoice.isApply}, #{saleInvoice.isPos}, #{saleInvoice.isNoneVat}, #{saleInvoice.isDeposit}, #{saleInvoice.isApprove}, #{saleInvoice.isDepositReference}, #{saleInvoice.status}, #{saleInvoice.created}, #{saleInvoice.createdBy} )

UPDATE sales_orders SET

mapper.select: SELECT sales_orders.created AS created, sales_orders.created_by AS createdBy FROM sales_orders WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT SUM(sales_orders.total_amount) FROM sales_order_apply_deposits INNER JOIN sales_orders ON sales_orders.id = sales_order_apply_deposits.sales_order_apply_deposit_id WHERE sales_order_apply_deposits.sales_order_id = #{saleInvoiceId} GROUP BY sales_order_apply_deposits.sales_order_id

SELECT IFNULL(limit_balance,0) AS limitBalance, IFNULL(limit_total_invoice,0) AS limitInvoice, IFNULL((SELECT SUM(balance) FROM sales_orders WHERE status > 0 AND customer_id = #{organizationId}),0) AS currentBalance, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(id) FROM sales_orders WHERE status > 0 AND customer_id = #{organizationId} AND balance > 0),0) AS currentInvoice FROM customers WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = #{organizationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sales_order_receipts ( sales_order_id, exchange_rate_id, currency_center_id, chart_account_id, receipt_code, amount_us, amount_other, total_amount, balance, balance_other, `change`, change_other, pay_date, due_date, created, created_by ) VALUES ( #{receipt.salesInvoiceId}, IFNULL(#{receipt.exchangeRateId}, (SELECT id FROM `exchange_rates` WHERE is_active = 1 AND currency_center_id = 2 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1)), #{receipt.currencyCenterId}, #{receipt.chartAccountId}, #{receipt.receiptCode}, #{receipt.amountUsd}, #{receipt.amountOther}, #{receipt.totalAmount}, #{receipt.balance}, #{receipt.balanceOther}, #{receipt.change}, #{receipt.changeOther}, #{receipt.date}, #{receipt.aging}, NOW(), #{receipt.createdBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT sales_order_receipts.id AS id, sales_order_receipts.exchange_rate_id AS exchangeRateId, companies.currency_center_id AS baseCurrencyCenterId, base.name AS baseCurrencyCenterName, base.symbol AS baseCurrencyCenterSymbol, sales_order_receipts.currency_center_id AS currencyCenterId, currency_centers.name AS currencyCenterName, currency_centers.symbol AS currencyCenterSymbol, (SELECT rate_to_sell FROM company_currencies WHERE currency_center_id = currency_centers.id AND exchange_rate_id = sales_order_receipts.exchange_rate_id LIMIT 1) AS rateToSell, sales_order_receipts.receipt_code AS receiptCode, sales_order_receipts.chart_account_id AS chartAccountId, CONCAT_WS(' - ', chart_accounts.account_codes, chart_accounts.account_description) AS chartAccountName, (SELECT reference FROM receive_payments WHERE id IN (SELECT receive_payment_id FROM general_ledgers WHERE is_active = 1 AND sales_order_receipt_id = sales_order_receipts.id) LIMIT 1) AS receivePaymentCode, sales_order_receipts.amount_us AS paidUsd, sales_order_receipts.amount_other AS paidOther, sales_order_receipts.total_amount AS totalAmount, sales_order_receipts.balance AS balance, sales_order_receipts.balance_other AS balanceOther, sales_order_receipts.due_date AS aging, DATE(sales_order_receipts.created) AS `date`, sales_order_receipts.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy, sales_order_receipts.is_void AS isVoid FROM sales_order_receipts INNER JOIN sales_orders ON sales_orders.id = sales_order_receipts.sales_order_id INNER JOIN companies ON companies.id = sales_orders.company_id INNER JOIN chart_accounts ON chart_accounts.id = sales_order_receipts.chart_account_id LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = sales_order_receipts.modified_by LEFT JOIN currency_centers AS base ON base.id = companies.currency_center_id LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = sales_order_receipts.currency_center_id WHERE sales_order_receipts.sales_order_id = #{filter.salesInvoiceId}

SELECT sales_order_receipts.id AS id, sales_order_receipts.sales_order_id AS salesInvoiceId, sales_order_receipts.exchange_rate_id AS exchangeRateId, sales_order_receipts.currency_center_id AS currencyCenterId, sales_order_receipts.amount_us AS paidUsd, sales_order_receipts.amount_other AS paidOther, sales_order_receipts.is_void AS isVoid, IFNULL(( SELECT rate_to_sell FROM company_currencies WHERE currency_center_id = sales_order_receipts.currency_center_id AND exchange_rate_id = sales_order_receipts.exchange_rate_id LIMIT 1 ), 0) AS rateToSell FROM sales_order_receipts WHERE sales_order_receipts.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
